status: candidate; automated validation complete; live acceptance open
ci_evidence: Exact published branch-head results and links are recorded on the consolidated pull request; local results do not imply hosted CI success.
limitations: Current live game version and paired server-accepted recovery, status clearance, hit rate, minigame grades, flight, motion, stamina, feeding and reward outcomes were not verified.
Territory autonomous native climb, flight/altitude and underwater-depth route adapters remain unsupported; native/manual controls retain priority.
Recurring Territory capacity is implemented and simulation-tested; real whole-map retention, deadline calibration and unattended multi-hour outcomes remain unverified.
No universal damage-reduction mechanism or authoritative server handler is available; captured species-specific shell calculations do not establish universal or server-accepted mitigation.
Actual device frame times, memory and current-game visual behavior remain unmeasured; operation-count comparisons and simulated durations are not live performance.
Fixed private native layouts and the Hippo scalar adapter are restricted to captured build 2412; missing introspection preserves ordinary native input without guaranteeing optional buffered retries.
Same-place lobby/respawn lifecycle is covered in mocks; cross-place teleport reinjection is not provided.
